spans.s: भृंग (I) m. 1. The large black bee, Bh.V.iv.29, R.viii.53, Bt.vi.73; 2. a kind of wasp; 3. a kind of bird; 4. a lecher, a libertine; 5. a jar, a pitcher.
भृंग (II) n. Talc.
भृंग-अभीष्ट m. the mango tree.
भृंग-आनंद f. the yūthikā creeper.
भृंग-आवली f. a flight of bees.
भृंग-ज n. 1. aloe wood; 2. talc.
भृंग-पर्णिका f. small cardamoms.
भृंग-राज् m. 1. a species of large bee; 2. name of a shrub.
भृंग-रिट्, -रिटि m. name of one of the attendants of Śiva.
भृंग-रिट्, -रिटि m. name of one of the attendants of Śiva.
भृंग-रोल m. a kind of wasp.
भृंग-वल्लभ m. a species of kadamba.
भृंगार (I) m.n. 1. A golden pitcher; 2. a pitcher of a particular shape; 3. a vessel used at the inauguration of a king.
भृंगार (II) n. 1. Gold; 2. cloves.
भृंगारिका f. a cricket.
भृंगारिका f. a cricket.
भृंगी m. Name of an attendant of Śiva.
भृंगी f. The female of the large black bee, अपि भ्राम्यद्‌भृंगीरणितरमणीया न मुकुलप्रसूतिश्चूतानां सखि शिखरिणीयं सुखयति Git.G.ii.
भृंगिन् m. 1. The Indian fig tree; 2. name an attendant of Śiva.
भृंगिरि(री)टि m. The same as भृंगरिटि q.v.
भृंगिरि(री)टि m. The same as भृंगरिटि q.v.
भृंगेरिटि m. Name of an attendant of Śiva.
भृंटिका f. A species of plant.
भृंडि f. A way.
